sections.name: Three Deadly Doors
lines: A prisoner gets one last chance to escape. There are three doors. Behind the first is a raging fire.
A prisoner gets one last chance to escape. There are three doors. Behind the first is a raging fire.
Behind the second, assassins with sharp swords. Behind the third, lions that have not eaten in three years.
Behind the second, assassins with sharp swords. Behind the third, lions that haven't eaten in three years.
Which door is the safest? You have 10 seconds. Think!
Which door is the safest? You have 10 seconds. Think!
Lions that have not eaten in three years would have starved long ago. The room is safe.
